acceptance: Record real upstream identity, fork protected integration and complete fork validation/delivery provenance at the actual merged source SHA.
Record core adoption PR, trusted delivery origin/hash binding, minimal core integration/packaging proof, ordinary review/CI and protected squash merge.
Live core develop pin/archive identity is the accepted delivery or a subsequently newer accepted delivery; no routine manual producer or consumer command was needed.
No eligible clean release means certification remains open with the external wait explicit, never a manufactured no-op success.

description: After capability activation, observe one real eligible clean upstream release through FORK-owned discovery/refresh/protected merge, complete fork validation and trusted exact-merged-SHA wheel delivery, then CORE-only download/identity/hash binding, transactional pin update, unique consumer integration/packaging checks, ordinary core review/CI and protected squash merge. No core source reconstruction or second semantics review, no Theseus changes, no routine manual merge/build/adopt command. Record actual version/SHAs/run/attempt/artifact/digest, fork PR and core adoption PR identities plus live develop pin/archive hash. A no-op or exception-only release does not prove success. If none is eligible, remain open rather than fabricate a tag or production pin-change probe.
